_why: Classification for scripts/verify-code-app-variant-parity.py (TAD docs/architecture/trustee-portal-design-2-architecture.md §5.3, ADR-056 as amended by ADR-060). Every file under the two apps is CONTRACT (byte-identical in both) or PRESENTATION (may differ), by glob; a file in neither list or in both fails (P5). Every entry names the ADR that decides it; an entry that matches no file fails (P4). Adding or moving an entry is a reviewed, committed change: moving a contract TEST to presentation needs an ADR that authorises the behaviour change it pins (ADR-060 rule 2), never a red build (rule 3). Retiring either app deletes this file (TAD §9.4 step 4).

contract.reason: Data shaping, redaction, visibility, field catalogue, formatting, chart labels (WI-0013) and colours (categoricalColor), list, group and slot logic.
The only data access: schema, client, repository, the round-statistics parser (ADR-065 changes it in both apps together).
CLI-generated services and the build-derived restricted-field catalogue.
Queries and page titles: no new state in the card app.
Generated per data source; the same 7 tables in both apps.
The shell's markup, nav order (WI-0052), skip link and composition root. The shell is restyled through CSS only (§13.1).
The Fluent theme and its ADR-037 ramp.
The design-system components' markup and their tests: 44px targets, focus handling, label binding.
The only write path; EF-05's mandatory note; Fluent's modal focus management.
Tokens, ADR-037's contrast corrections, ADR-036/042 fonts. New values go in card-only stylesheets.
The logo and the self-hosted Playfair Display faces.

Every test not listed under presentation: the first app's tests pin the card app's content and behaviour (headings, captions, nav order, WI-0013, WI-0053, EF-05, ADR-037's token corrections). Includes src/styles/layout.test.ts, rewritten in both apps under TAD §5.3 rule 1 (Revision 3.2) to assert only accessibility properties.
One dependency set, one toolchain and one test setup.
The unit-test harness, and the detail harness that mounts the layout spec unchanged.

presentation.reason: Panels, tables, charts, filters, finance panel, distribution chart.

Card-only presentation modules and their tests: the shared status-tone map, the computed sentences (ADR-062, §13.7), the application-share bar (ADR-065), the HTML chart shapes and CategoryBars (ADR-063).
The card app's row-to-display map and its test.
app.module.css, ds.module.css, detail.module.css, print.css and any card-only module: the look.
Visual specs measure each app's own geometry.
index.html (static title) and the harness entries.
The card displays and the three redaction states in their new look.
Pins the card blocks' print rules.
The card app's stamp and hand-entered wording (R11, R12); split out of LandingPage.test.tsx in both apps.
The design bars' positive properties: labelled, one per category in series order, proportional. The negative half stays in the two contract WI-0053 tests.

Per-app identity (P3 still compares data sources, connectors and appIds) and per-app byte budget. A-TR-14: the new appId is null until the first push assigns one. A-CRD-1: the connectionReferences block, key included, is copied from the first app on the assumption that a second app in the same environment may reuse the same connection reference; the first push confirms or replaces it.
